richardson_extrapolation_1_over_n_peri_l.method: Linear fit of L vs 1/n_peri using last 2-3 points

production_value.rationale: Panel default. ~1 s solve time vs ~88 s at n_peri=64; 1.78% under-prediction acceptable for engineering use.

bema_convergence.description: BEM-A (Weggler stabilized EFIE on HDivSurface RT0 + SIBC) mesh sweep via ngsolve.bem.LaplaceSL with use_fmm=False (dense LU).

unreachable.reason: Dense saddle LU (scipy.linalg.solve) OOM at K = 37429^2 = 22 GB; MINRES (scipy.sparse.linalg.minres, rtol=1e-8, no preconditioner) ran 107 min CPU and grew memory to 61 GB without converging.  Production-grade BEM-A above 10k tris requires HACApK/FMM acceleration.

bema_convergence.convergence_assessment: NON-MONOTONIC. 4028-tri value 432.57 nH coincidentally matches PEEC continuum (~434) but is not part of a monotonic refinement sequence. Of the 3 valid data points, 5938 -> 9848 shows monotonic drop from 417.56 to 412.18 (cap discretization improved 6/6 -> 14/14, refining the Lagrange multiplier space).

richardson_extrapolation_estimate.method: Crude 1/sqrt(N) and 1/N fits on 5938 + 9848 only -- 2 data points, large uncertainty
richardson_extrapolation_estimate.note: 4028-tri excluded as off-trend.  14972-tri needed to confirm.  Cannot make a confident statement of BEM-A continuum from current data.

R_coil_disparity.note: Mesh-independent. Points to formulation-level disagreement: PEEC uses Dowell analytical thin-skin formula for circular wire, BEM-A applies SIBC Robin BC on the surface with Z_s = 1/(sigma*delta). The two should agree in the thin-skin limit but diverge here.
R_coil_disparity.status_2026_07_03: SUPERSEDED / RESOLVED. The 0.39 mOhm PEEC value here is the pre-2026-05-19 R_DC bug (Bessel skin not injected); with Bessel skin PEEC R = 4.5 mOhm. The 4.72 mOhm BEM-A value is the retired PEC path (mesh-divergent). With the impedance-EFIE, BEM-A R = 4.63 mOhm and the methods AGREE. See raw_payload.closure_2026_07_03.

candidates_for_inductive_disagreement: (i) PEEC parallel-transport frame + finite n_peri perimeter discretization of round wire
(ii) BEM-A SIBC accuracy at finite delta_skin/r = 0.054 (classical SIBC assumes infinitely thin skin)
(iii) Lead-bar / helix junction treatment differs across formulations
(iv) BEM-A non-monotonicity at 4028/5938 suggests under-resolved surface mesh

R_agreement_kubota_3turn_150kHz.note: R is the PRIMARY engineering metric and now agrees across methods. The old PEC BEM-A path (mesh-divergent SIBC breakdown, 2.90 coarse -> 15.14 fine) is REMOVED.

L_gap_kubota_3turn.verdict: KNOWN BENIGN geometry/convention difference, LEFT AS-IS (not a defect).
L_gap_kubota_3turn.why: surface mesh != PEEC filament geometry (effective loop / leads / gap / centerline) + PEEC finite n_peri + external-L(BEM) vs bundle-L(PEEC) convention. 430 nH is PEEC's own approximation, not validated truth (FEM A-V 3-D reference still TBD).

curve_order_study.question: Does raising BEM-A geometry curve order move L toward PEEC 430 nH?
curve_order_study.fixture: gapped_torus_2port.vol, 150 kHz, HDivSurface RT0 (fes_order=0), fixed n_J=5745
curve_order_study.finding: L and R are BIT-IDENTICAL across curve_order 1/2/3. mesh.Curve(p) is a NO-OP here because the in-memory _extract_surface_mesh_filtered surface has no CAD/curvedelements association (nothing to project the mid-side nodes onto). Even properly applied, curve order is not the lever: external L is loop-dominated (turn radius, enclosed area, N^2) and round-wire faceting enters L only logarithmically (ln(8R/a)) = sub-1%.
real_levers_if_L_ever_needs_reconciling: match the SAME STEP geometry between BEM surface and PEEC filaments
h-refine the surface mesh (+ mesh-convergence check)
anchor to FEM A-V (calc_fem_coilmesh.py) or measurement

scalable_solver.name: loop-COCR / HACApK-COCR
choices: cocr        : div-free loop reduction + COCR, dense SL matvec
hacapk_cocr : same COCR, HACApKBEMManager O(N log N) SL matvec
scalable_solver.note: div-free loop reduction makes complex-symmetric COCR fit; EXACT vs dense LU (dR/dL < 0.01%). coil_inductance_ngsolve.compute_inductance_source_sink(solver='cocr'|'hacapk_cocr'); auto picks cocr for large N.
